messages:
maria: Planned rollout tonight 02:00 UTC — kernel 1.4.2 + quant-profile slim-v2. Canary 2% for 30m, then 20% for 30m if green. I am primary rollout owner. pls ack who is on deploy + who watches metrics and rollback.
alex: I can be deploy lead for the 02:00 UTC window, will be available 01:45–03:30 UTC. slot claim done. :white_check_mark:
jonas: I'll watch p99 latency, error rate, and model-quality regression (eval set). Can post snapshots to #eng-runtime-monitor every 5m.
ryan: I'll stand by for rollback. Have the rollback job and previous artifact pinned (kernel-1.4.1 + slim-v1). can trigger from my laptop if needed.
deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: docker images available, infra quota OK, canary slice allocation clear.
sre-oncall: I'll be on pager coverage during the window. Please post smoke checklist and the exact rollback command.
maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- run small prompt through /v1/generate on canary
- check token-per-second and tail latency on per-route dashboard
- verify kv-cache hit ratio >= baseline
- confirm no spike in 5xx
Commands:
```
# quick sanity curl
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"test-slim-v2","input":"Hello"}'
```
And rollback trigger (manual):
```
# rollback to pinned release
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=runtime --release=kernel-1.4.1+slim-v1 --force
```
alex: Got it. Small Q: does the canary route include a tracing tag so we can filter spans for slim-v2 only?
jonas: yes, I added header X-RW-Canary: slim-v2 in the router; spans are tagged canary.slim-v2. I'll also enable a temporary trace-sampling bump.
maria: Note: automatic fallback policy exists (fallback to cpu-backup model if runtime panics) but manual rollback is fastest to revert quant profile.
alex: Kicking off canary now (02:00:15 UTC). I'll post updates. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started by alex — release kernel-1.4.2 + slim-v2 — canary slice 2% — id: rel_2149998765
alex: Canary applied, traffic routing stable. Running smoke checks now.
jonas: smoke run 1/3: prompt RT 85ms, tail 310ms, 5xx 0, kv-hit 0.92 — looks fine so far.
alex: smoke run 2/3 ok. Posting quick logs for reference:
```
[worker-42] INFO model loaded: slim-v2 quant OK
[worker-42] WARN small memory bump +2%
```
jonas: metrics steady across 10m window. No model-quality drift on eval subset. :thumbsup:
ryan: rollback still armed but standing down. if we need, I'll run the rollback command in <2m.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor infra alarms and step in if any host-level OOMs or GPU errors show up.
alex: Moving to 20% ramp in 10m if no issues. Will post when ramp starts.
maria: Thanks team — callout: if anyone sees p50>200ms or 5xx>0.5% escalate immediately and tag @sre-oncall. Otherwise proceed with the planned ramp. Good job so far.
